title: Traditional German Braised Squash
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring tender squash in a rich, flavorful broth. Serve with crusty bread or over mashed potatoes for an authentic experience.
instructions: Heat the fry in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the squash, caraway seeds, beef broth, apple cider vinegar, wholesome, salt, and pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the squash is tender.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
